description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_options} function, which generates HTML select and option tags based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering options and option groups, and handles external dependencies for escaping special characters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Main function that generates HTML select element with options based on parameters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Generates individual <option> tags or delegates to generate option groups.
